task_description: Build a complete mobile-first Quran web application called 'Muslim Pedia' using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, styled after quran.al-midror.web.id. Features include: surah listing, ayah reading with Arabic text and Indonesian translation, audio playback, bookmarks, search, settings (dark mode, font size, reciter selection), last-read tracking, and PWA support. Uses equran.id API for data.
